name: employee-attendance-monitoring-system
description: Employee WFH Attendance and HRD Monitoring Microservices System

scripts.start:dev: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUDIT,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix apps/api-gateway run start:dev" "npm --prefix apps/audit-service run start:dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api-gateway run build && npm --prefix apps/audit-service run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix apps/api-gateway run db:setup && npm --prefix apps/audit-service run db:setup
